taxonomy_note: The existing validation evidence model has no generic public authoritative-source trust class. This policy uses public_dataset for public non-competitor research and public_competitor for vendor documentation, without changing the core taxonomy.

EV-0001.rationale: Public consumer guidance supports market-context research but is not first-party behavioural evidence.

EV-0004.rationale: Published consumer survey evidence is public secondary research and cannot satisfy the primary threshold.

EV-0006.rationale: Regulatory guidance informs the messaging-compliance risk boundary rather than customer demand.

EV-0008.rationale: Vendor documentation verifies existing quotation-reminder capability and therefore belongs in competitor evidence.

EV-0009.rationale: Vendor documentation verifies existing follow-up automation and stopping conditions.

EV-0010.rationale: Vendor documentation verifies configurable quotation chasing and informs the competitive baseline.

EV-0011.rationale: Vendor documentation verifies quotation follow-up, approval and deposit workflows.

EV-0012.rationale: Vendor documentation verifies online quotation acceptance and status-tracking functionality.

EV-0013.rationale: A bounded public forum self-report is weak qualitative secondary research, not a customer interview.
